period_note: RESTATEMENT-RELEVANT PERIOD -- the last interim filing before the FY2023 annual report (which reported a profit later restated to a loss). Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/standalone, Shariah-based Islamic bank. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January (9-month cumulative), as published in the bank's own 'CONDENSED PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (Un-audited) For the Period (Q-3) From 01 January 2023 to 30 September 2023'; the filing's own table also prints a discrete 'July'23-Sept'23' column, captured as the _discrete_quarter fields. Source PDF ('3rd_Quarter_Financial_Statement_as_on_30_September_2023.pdf', filed with a 'Date: 30 October 2023' signature block) is a SCANNED IMAGE document -- independently OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract). Balance-sheet identity reconciles exactly: Total Liabilities (262,898,689,754) + Total Equity (16,102,314,103) = Total Assets (279,001,003,857). P&L chain reconciles exactly: Total Operating Income (5,869,879,173) - Total Operating Expenses (2,873,664,560) = Profit before Provision and Tax (2,996,214,613); - Total Provisions (553,500,000) = Total Profit before Tax (2,442,714,613); - Tax (1,075,211,231) = Net Profit after Tax (1,367,503,382). This filing's own 'Investments Income' and 'Profit Paid on Deposits' cells for the CURRENT period (Jan-Sep 2023) were not legibly OCR'd (the row rendered only the PRIOR-year comparative, Jan-Sep 2022, which duplicates this dataset's own 2022_Q3.json figures exactly -- confirming the OCR read the correct row, just the wrong column for this specific cell); the current-period gross Investments Income used here (16,760.23m) is instead cross-referenced from Union Bank's own 2024 Q3 filing, which reproduces 'Jan'23-Sept'23' as its prior-year comparative -- Profit Paid on Deposits (-11,688.60m) is then basis 'calculated_from_pl_components' (= Investments Income minus Net Investment Income, both independently confirmed). CROSS-CHECK AGAINST FY2023 ANNUAL (2023_Q4.json): 9-month cumulative Net Profit after Tax (1,367.50m) implies a Q4-2023-ALONE profit of 1,607.89m (FY2023 total, this dataset's stored ORIGINAL/contemporaneous figure) minus 1,367.50m = 240.39m -- a plausible, unremarkable Q4 profit consistent with the ORIGINAL FY2023 filing's own internal consistency; there is no way to test this against the LATER-RESTATED FY2023 figures (-2,875.22m loss) using only this Q1-Q3 data, since Union Bank's restated comparative was only ever published at the FY2023 BALANCE-SHEET-DATE level (a single point-in-time restatement in the FY2024 report), not as a restated quarterly trail -- i.e. no interim filing anywhere in this dataset shows a 'restated' Q1/Q2/Q3 2023 column. RESTATEMENT TIMING FINDING (the central point of this bank's Q1-Q3 backfill): like Q1 and Q2 2023, this filing shows continued healthy, GROWING cumulative profit (1,367.50m vs 1,324.62m in 9M-2022) and growing equity (16,102.31m, up from 15,584.84m in Q2) -- absolutely no visible sign of the classified-investment-data manipulation later disclosed in the FY2024 annual report. Every single 2023 interim filing (Q1, Q2, Q3) shows a smoothly improving trajectory; whatever went wrong was either not yet reflected in the underlying investment classifications as of these filing dates, or was already present but successfully concealed by the same manipulated system-generated reports that Bangladesh Bank's 29-April-2025 letter later found -- this dataset's data cannot distinguish between those two explanations, only confirm that neither the bank's interim disclosures nor (per the contemporaneous FY2023 audit opinion, unqualified) its year-end audit caught it at the time. The condensed quarterly filing does NOT disclose classified investments, NPL ratio, or CRAR/capital-adequacy figures.
